entities.name: Tuğba Şenoğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tuğba Şenoğlu İvegin is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 1.84 m tall and plays in the wing spiker position for Türk Hava Yolları in Turkey. She is part of the team which qualified for the postponed 2020 Summer Olympics.
